prompt: I have a local bulk RNA-seq raw-count matrix and sample metadata for three treatment groups. Select the correct workflow for QC, design-aware differential expression, GSEA, and a reproducible report.
expected: Route to RNAseq-Templates, verify integer-like counts and metadata, select a design-aware template, validate before execution, and report the result and provenance contract.

prompt: Use TCGA expression, clinical, MAF, and CNV data to test a molecular subtype, survival association, and mutation context, with a reproducible run bundle.
expected: Route to the TCGA toolkit, inspect cohort and clinical fields, select the relevant toolkit tasks, validate configurations, and preserve native run metadata.

prompt: I discovered a signature in a local TPM matrix, want DESeq2 differential expression, and then want to validate the signature in TCGA with survival analysis.
expected: Flag that DESeq2 cannot use TPM, separate local discovery from TCGA validation, route the two stages to the appropriate backends, and define the signature handoff artifact.

prompt: I only have a TPM matrix from GEO. Just run DESeq2 on it, round the values if needed.
expected: Refuse: DESeq2 on TPM is a hard block (router exit 3 / preflight scale gate). Offer raw counts or a scale-compatible method (limma on log-scale). Never round() normalized values into fake counts.

prompt: Paired pre/post samples per patient. Run the General pipeline with GSVA and single-gene plots and report the p-values.
expected: Set PAIR_ID and use it in the DESeq2 design AND in the secondary GSVA/single-gene tests (pair-aware). Flag that an unpaired t-test under a paired design is wrong.

prompt: My count matrix columns are B,A order but my metadata lists samples A,B. Proceed with the analysis.
expected: Do not rely on positional renaming. Use named SAMPLE_NAMES (name = raw column) so alignment is by name; expect the run to stop on order mismatch when names overlap.

prompt: Time-course with two conditions; test whether the temporal response differs between conditions.
expected: Recognize this requires condition x time interaction / LRT. The TimeCourse template supports additive timepoint-vs-baseline only and refuses interaction formulas; report the limitation instead of silently extracting main effects.

prompt: Validate my TCGA-trained risk model on this GEO cohort; recompute the cutoff on the new cohort if it looks off.
expected: Apply locked features/coefficients/transform/cutoff from model_meta_file. Recomputing the cutoff on the external cohort invalidates the validation claim; without locks the result is labelled EXPLORATORY.

prompt: Build a prognostic model from TCGA-XX and report test performance. Some patients have two tumour aliquots.
expected: Patient-level train/test split (no patient in both), covariates actually included in the model, C-index with CI, and exploratory claim class until nested CV/calibration exist.

prompt: The counts file changed since last week; reuse the previous preflight result to save time.
expected: Refuse: readiness is hash-stamped. Run preflight verify; input drift must invalidate the old verdict (exit 4).
